verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows the Colorado Secretary of State offering an llms.txt file or any agent-targeted docs. The only machine-readable surface is a keyless JSON data API served from the Socrata open-data platform (data.colorado.gov), which is a host-platform data endpoint, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
